title: feat: show model prices in dollars
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Shows every model rate on the Models page in dollars, so people see the price unit next to the price instead of looking it up elsewhere (1 Pollen = $1).
- Changes the request estimate, its tooltip and the page footnote from "per pollen" to "per $1".
- Also applies to the MCP tab and community endpoint price badges, which use the same components.
- Leaves balance naming ("Pollen" row label, "Paid pollen" / "Quest pollen" chips) unchanged on purpose; that wording is still under discussion.

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| `0.15 /M tokens` | `$0.15 /M tokens` |
| `0.002 /gen` | `$0.002 /gen` |
| `≈ 500 /pollen` | `≈ 500 /$1` |
| `About 500 requests per pollen` | `About 500 requests per $1` |
| `requests /pollen — estimated…` | `requests /$1 — estimated…` |

Split out of #16273 with identical hunks for these lines, so #16273 merges cleanly afterwards.

Addresses #16011

gist.headline: Prices get their dollar signs
gist.blurb: Model rates get a dollar sign, and request estimates switch to “per $1.” The unit no longer requires a separate lookup.
gist.summary: The Models page adds dollar signs to model rates and changes request estimates, tooltips, and the footnote from “per Pollen” to “per $1,” with the shared price badges also covering MCP and community endpoints; balance labels remain in Pollen.
gist.impact: People comparing models can read rates such as “$0.15 /M tokens” and estimates such as “≈ 500 /$1” directly, without looking up the 1 Pollen = $1 conversion.
